biggest_catch: 14-14.5 hour Election Day (5:30am to usually 8:00-8:30pm) for a flat $167.90-$219.52, plus mandatory unpaid-duration training that is folded into the flat pay.
catches: Election Day window is 5:30am to about 8:00-8:30pm (14-14.5 hours); pay is flat per role, not hourly.
At least one mandatory training session is required; its duration is not stated and it is included in the flat Election Day pay.
Must be a US citizen and registered voter of Onslow County; cannot hold elective office, be a candidate, or hold party office/manager/treasurer roles.
Compensation is per role: $219.52 for Chief Judges, $167.90 for Judges and Assistants.

steps: Be a US citizen and registered voter of Onslow County; of good repute and able to read and write; not hold elective office, candidacy, or party/treasurer offices.
Complete the Pollworker Interest Form (PDF) on the Onslow County Board of Elections Poll Worker Resources page.
Attend at least one mandatory training session before working Election Day (training included in Election Day pay).
Work Election Day from 5:30am until closing procedures are complete (usually 8:00-8:30pm) as an appointed Chief Judge, Judge, or Assistant.
timing: Election Day per the county election calendar; mandatory training session before working.
